Dotwel Widgets is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Nothing Technology Limited, OnePlus, Kustom, or the referenced authors. This is a debug candidate, not Play-approved or runtime-verified.
Category previews use the same renderers as placed widgets. Dotted clocks and styled analog/world previews are bitmaps refreshed about once a minute when optional Alarms & reminders access is on; otherwise the live platform clock is shown. Battery readouts come from the system battery level. The Mini preset has no text layer, so Dotwel adds the real level in its own dot glyphs; no charge state is invented. Battery2 shows only a real charging-time estimate from the system while charging; it never invents discharge hours or minutes and says the estimate is unavailable when Android has no value.

Adapted author-written behaviour: NtDraw.SCHEME/color/surface/fit/center/paint/shadow to UpstreamNtDraw.kt; NtDigital.build to NtDigitalRenderer.kt; NtDate.build to NtDateRenderer.kt; NtAnalogBold.build and NtAnalogScale.build to NtAnalogRenderer.kt and BaseWidgetProvider.kt; NtWorld.build to NtWorldRenderer.kt; NtQuotes.build drawing block to NtQuotesRenderer.kt; NtProvider update loop/resize/tap to BaseWidgetProvider.kt; NtStyle to WidgetPrefs.kt; NtTick to MinuteTickScheduler.kt. No smali bytecode, APK resources, fonts or artwork are included.
KWGT-Widgets (MIT) Pinned commit 96ca27be4cbff35efec5a86c64dd39fd065c958f Copyright (c) 2024 Om Gupta. Adapted presets: Nothing_Battery.kwgt!preset.json to KwgtBatteryRenderer.kt, BatteryWidgetProvider.kt and sanitized data; Nothing_Battery_Mini.kwgt!preset.json to KwgtBatteryMiniRenderer.kt, BatteryMiniWidgetProvider.kt and sanitized data; Nothing_Battery2.kwgt!preset.json to KwgtBattery2Renderer.kt, KwgtBattery2WidgetProvider.kt, Battery2State and sanitized data; Nothing_Date_Time.kwgt!preset.json to KwgtDateTimeRenderer.kt, KwgtDateTimeWidgetProvider.kt and sanitized data; Nothing_Date_Time2.kwgt!preset.json to KwgtDateTime2Renderer.kt, KwgtDateTime2WidgetProvider.kt and sanitized data; Nothing_Digital4.kwgt!preset.json to KwgtDigital4Renderer.kt, KwgtDigital4WidgetProvider.kt and sanitized data; Nothing_Digital3.kwgt!preset.json to KwgtDigital3Renderer.kt, KwgtDigital3WidgetProvider.kt and sanitized data; Nothing_Digital.kwgt!preset.json to KwgtGradientClockRenderer.kt, KwgtGradientClockWidgetProvider.kt and sanitized data; Nothing_Mini_Calender.kwgt!preset.json to KwgtMiniCalendarRenderer.kt, KwgtMiniCalendarDates.kt, KwgtMiniCalendarWidgetProvider.kt and sanitized data; Nothing_Analog_3.kwgt!preset.json to KwgtAnalog3WidgetProvider.kt, three native vector layouts and sanitized data; Nothing_Analog_.kwgt!preset.json to KwgtAnalogSecondsWidgetProvider.kt, three base plus three v31 native vector layouts and sanitized data; Nothing_Analog_5.kwgt!preset.json to KwgtAnalog5WidgetProvider.kt, three native vector layouts, vector tick-ring dial/hands and sanitized data; Nothing_Analog_5_Transparent.kwgt!preset.json to KwgtAnalog5TransparentWidgetProvider.kt, three native vector layouts, clear-cut vector dials/hands and sanitized data; Nothing_Digital_Clock.kwgt!preset.json to KwgtOrbitClockWidgetProvider.kt, three native orbit layouts, vector dial/hands and sanitized data. Only 20 of 40 presets are implemented; the remaining 20 stay pending or dependency-blocked and are not claimed as imported.
Original substitutions: Dotwel’s 5x7 circular-dot glyphs replace upstream fonts. Platform serif and sans-serif-condensed families replace NType, Lettera and Ndot. Weather uses the optional Open-Meteo service (CC BY 4.0), with data by Open-Meteo: https://open-meteo.com/ and terms at https://open-meteo.com/en/terms. Weather is off by default, uses only a manually searched city, and requests nothing until enabled. No upstream screenshots, logos, fonts, presets, APK, or OEM OnePlus code/assets are bundled.
The exact adapted-file mapping and the 40-preset ledger are retained in docs/ATTRIBUTION.md and docs/KWGT-LEDGER.md.
